svg.title: A Claude Code session and a Codex session share a checkout, each given a short task brief with a prescribed coordination scenario and pointed at the buddy skill, the buddy commands their own choice: the Claude session claims the file and edits it; the Codex session reads the repo's agent rules and the skill, registers, has its claim REFUSED by the ledger naming the holder, messages it and declares a blocking wait; the Claude session hands its claim over; the Codex session's wait LANDS, its patch is allowed, and it releases
svg.desc: The pane output is transcribed from the pane text each session's user saw, read with herdr pane read after the run (the harnesses' collapsed summaries included), captured 2026-10-26 in a scratch clone with its own ledger; the two transcripts (Claude Code JSONL, Codex rollout JSONL) give the clocks that interleave the panes, which also split one Codex cell (its blocking wait: the call and BLOCKING line at the call's time, the LANDED lines when they arrived) and place a # … marker after it where the pane lists that cell before. Added by hand: the pane titles and the # lines, that is the one ⏩ line naming the real time between the beats around it and the # … lines marking cells not drawn. Edits to captured text: the scratch directory is written …, long lines are soft-wrapped at 58 columns with continuations indented as the panes indent them, and a … ending a Codex line is Codex's own trim at its pane width; no word changes. Loops every 36 s; under prefers-reduced-motion the final frame is shown still.
